integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and a standalone, finite exact-arithmetic checker; finite enumeration is not an all-dimension proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one odd rim cycle and at least one pendant leaf; no deeper hanging trees. The claim concerns the difference of Ehrhart counts and not the entire count. Priority beyond inspected publications remains open.
title: A universal simplex and Ehrhart parity correction for pendant-decorated odd-cycle matching polytopes
